scope_notes: No dedicated development MCP registry exists: internal.py defines registry infrastructure. Three shared communications tools are mapped for channel bring-up; full service coverage belongs to communications.
test-types audit/suppressions are local contributor CLI operations with no MCP or HTTP equivalent. Shared quality, native hook/schema and code-index initialization entries preserve primary ownership.

Native guides supply contributor navigation and current entry/ownership/recovery contracts. Detailed code-index search/index/graph operations retain the code-index audit; terminal operator workflows retain sessions/agents/admin ownership.

No installed rule/profile/workflow/backend is asserted active. Template defaults and historical landing records are explicitly source/history evidence; actual installed/effective rows must be inspected when operating.
No Rust/Python/TS production or test implementation changed. Native builds here are test builds, not a deployment; no binary reinstall or daemon restart is required by this documentation-only leaf.

No live channel parity, physical remote-client deployment, full terminal Guard H, or platform socket-policy acceptance is claimed. Those remain required for their implementation tasks, not blanket gates introduced by this library.
